summary:
Frontend-only UI/UX + responsive validation of (1) KYC grace countdown banner on /dashboard, (2) Individual->Business upgrade flow via CompanySelector chip AND Settings Account details card, and (3) responsive rendering at 1920x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile. Logged in as onarrival21@gmail.com (two-step: email->Continue->password->Sign in). Verified fixture company 'KYC Test (Individual)' (company_id=111) is over $10k volume and NOT approved.

RESULTS (all PASS):
- Grace banner: renders on /dashboard when 111 selected with data-testid=kyc-grace-banner, data-testid=kyc-grace-days text='90 days to verify your identity', data-testid=kyc-grace-start-btn enabled (not clicked, per instructions). GET /api/kyc/status?company_id=111 -> 200 {requires_kyc:true, status:'not_started', is_exempt:false, blocked:false, grace_period.days_remaining:90}.
- Grace banner HIDDEN for 'The Dev Store' (company_id=1, business, KYC approved).
- Switcher chip: company-upgrade-111 present on the individual row; NO company-upgrade-1 or company-upgrade-71 on the business rows. Clicking company-upgrade-111 opens upgrade-business-modal.
- Modal (from switcher): upgrade-business-name-input prefilled 'KYC Test (Individual)'; upgrade-business-country-input Autocomplete accepts typed 'United Sta' and upgrade-country-option-US is visible+selectable; upgrade-business-website-input filled with https://acme-test.example.com; upgrade-business-vat-input present (left blank); upgrade-business-submit-btn enabled. After click PUT /api/company/upgrade-to-business/111 -> 200 {message:'Account upgraded to Business successfully!', data.account_type:'business'}. data-testid=upgrade-business-success renders "You're now a Business account" and the modal auto-closes after ~1.5s.
- Post-upgrade switcher: company-upgrade-111 is GONE and data-testid=company-type-111 now reads 'BUSINESS'. companyState.refetchCompanies() confirmed via 2x GET /api/company/getCompany after upgrade.
- Settings card (tested BEFORE upgrade, /settings -> 'Account details' section for individual 111): data-testid=settings-upgrade-business-card present + data-testid=settings-upgrade-business-btn present; clicking opens the same upgrade-business-modal.
- Mobile 390x844: banner renders full-width (390px), stacks vertically with full-width Start verification button (356x44 inside 390 viewport, no overflow). Switcher dropdown renders correctly with badges. Modal fullScreen sheet is implemented (fullScreen={isMobile}) — verified indirectly via the earlier desktop flow (already-upgraded 111 cannot be re-tested for full-screen modal in SAFE MODE since we can't revert the upgrade).

ui_bugs.issue: Banner does NOT render immediately after selecting a different company via the CompanySelector dropdown; requires a full page reload before it appears. Once mounted, it renders correctly. The /api/kyc/status?company_id=<id> XHR does fire and returns the expected {requires_kyc:true, status:'not_started', grace_period.days_remaining:90} payload, so this is a client-side render/state-sync issue in KycGraceBanner (likely SWR key/dedupe or an unmount-on-navigate quirk in pages/dashboard) rather than an API problem.

issues: React dev warning: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' from renderOption in Components/UI/UpgradeToBusinessModal/index.tsx (MUI v5+ requires key={someKey} passed directly, not via {...props}). Non-blocking dev-only warning.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on initial mount (pre-existing, not introduced by this change).

action_items: Fix KycGraceBanner to re-render on selectedCompanyId change without requiring a full reload — verify useSWR key derivation and consider mutate() on company switch, or move the fetch to CompanyDataContext.

Clean up the MUI Autocomplete renderOption in Components/UI/UpgradeToBusinessModal/index.tsx to pass the key explicitly: destructure `const { key, ...rest } = props;` and use `<Box component="li" key={key} {...rest} …>` to silence the React dev warning.
critical_code_review_comments: KycGraceBanner.tsx: revalidateOnFocus:false + revalidateIfStale:false + dedupingInterval:60_000 can make the banner appear stale after context-level company switch; the SWR key uses selectedCompanyId which should trigger a new request, but the render did not update until reload — recommend explicit mutate/refetch on company switch.
UpgradeToBusinessModal.tsx renderOption spreads MUI's props (which includes `key`) — small refactor to extract key silences a repeating dev warning and follows MUI v5 guidance.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 medium UX bug: banner requires reload on company switch)

seed_data_creation: None (SAFE MODE). However, the review's own instructions asked us to PERFORM the upgrade on company_id=111 as part of the flow. The upgrade succeeded (PUT /api/company/upgrade-to-business/111 -> 200) so company 111 is now account_type=business permanently for this DB. Any retest of the 'individual -> business' path will need a fresh individual fixture or a manual DB revert of company 111 back to account_type='individual'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is 2-step at /auth/login (email -> Continue -> password -> Sign in). The KYC grace banner requires a full page reload to render after switching companies via the CompanySelector — if you want to see it, either reload or navigate to /dashboard freshly with the desired company already selected. After this iteration, company_id=111 is BUSINESS (upgraded). To re-run the upgrade flow, ask backend to revert tbl_company.company_id=111.account_type back to 'individual' (and optionally clear country/website/vat that we set).
rca_of_the_issue: KYC banner-on-switch UX quirk: pages/dashboard.tsx renders <KycGraceBanner/> unconditionally (except for isMember). KycGraceBanner uses useSWR(['kyc/status', companyId ?? 'self'], fetchKyc). When selectedCompanyId changes, the SWR key changes and a network request DOES fire (verified via Playwright response listener: 200 for /api/kyc/status?company_id=111), yet the component's `data` still evaluates to a state that returns null on first paint after the switch. Full reload works because the initial useSWR call is made with the correct companyId from persisted context. Likely fix: subscribe to companyId with useEffect+mutate(key), or drop revalidateIfStale:false so SWR triggers a re-render when key changes with stale-in-cache data.
